display.purpose: Landing hero only. Syne 800, set very tight. One per page.

headline.purpose: Section headings on the marketing surface. Syne 700.

body.purpose: All prose. DM Sans 400 at a 16px floor, 65-75ch measure.

label.purpose: Eyebrows and small caps labels. DM Sans 600, 0.2em tracking.

shadows.name: tile-lip
shadows.purpose: The default raised surface. First shadow is the edge catching light; second is the ground beneath it.

shadows.name: tile-pressed
shadows.purpose: Paired with translateY(3px). The object under a finger.

shadows.name: green-glow
shadows.purpose: Pointer hover and genuinely lit elements only.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The system's out-curve. Every state transition uses it.

motion.name: duration-press
motion.purpose: Touch press feedback: scale(0.98) or a 3px depress.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Pointer hover: lift plus glow. Gated on (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

motion.name: duration-entrance
motion.purpose: Copy entrances. Never gate the primary action behind a stagger.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The marketing surface's primary action. Pill, lit green, physical lip.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 15px 32px; border-radius: 32px; background: linear-gradient(100deg, #23bd6a 0%, #0f673c 100%); color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 0 #0c5230, 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(15,103,60,0.4); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 0 #0c5230, 0 12px 26px -6px rgba(15,103,60,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 #0c5230, 0 2px 6px rgba(15,103,60,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 0 #0c5230, 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,217,138,0.5); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The fallback action. Same size and shape as primary; only the weight of the invitation differs.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 32px; background: transparent; border: 2px solid rgba(220,221,219,0.28); color: #dcdddb; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(52,217,138,0.75); color: #34d98a; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,217,138,0.5); }

components.name: App Button
components.description: The in-app action. Softened rectangle, 44px touch target. Syne never appears here.
components.css: .ds-btn-app { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: #1aa35a; color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.14s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-app:hover { background: #34d98a; color: #062b18; } .ds-btn-app:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-app:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,217,138,0.5); } .ds-btn-app:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Tactile Tile
components.description: The signature surface. A raised object with a light edge and a grounding shadow - it depresses when pressed rather than fading.
components.html: Check AvailabilityFind a medicine
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.045); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05), 0 10px 22px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.14s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.18s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-tile:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.09), 0 16px 30px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.62); } .ds-tile:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05), 0 5px 12px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06), 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,217,138,0.5); } .ds-tile-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(26,163,90,0.12); } .ds-tile-title { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #dcdddb; } .ds-tile-sub { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 16px text is a floor, not a preference - smaller triggers iOS auto-zoom.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search for a medicine" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: #dcdddb; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #b1bdb0; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: rgba(52,217,138,0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,217,138,0.5); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: The small caps eyebrow. Signal Green, never Dispensary Green - it is text.
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4ade80; }

components.name: App Navigation
components.description: Five destinations. Sticky top bar on desktop, fixed bottom bar on mobile. Signal Green marks the active item.
components.html: HomeReminders
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; background: rgba(11,12,9,0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 16px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: rgba(26,163,90,0.12); color: #34d98a; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,217,138,0.5); }

narrative.overview:
A real dispensary counter, lit and staffed, while the rest of the street is dark. Every decision in this system follows from that image. The near-black base (#0b0c09) is night, not fashion. The green is the lit sign you can see from the road. The calm, unhurried tone is a competent pharmacist who is simply still open - not a brand performing urgency.

This matters because the product's real adversary is doubt. In a market where counterfeit medicine is a live fear, the interface either reads as evidence that a licensed pharmacy exists behind it, or it reads as another reseller. Specificity is how the system argues: a named street, a named delivery area, a real person answering. Ornament is not part of the argument.

The system is physical rather than flat. Surfaces are objects: a tile carries a solid bottom lip - a light edge catching the room - and a grounding shadow beneath it, and it depresses when pressed. That tactility is the personality. It is what keeps a dark interface from reading as a void.
keyCharacteristics: Night-dark base, lit by a single green
Physical surfaces that respond to touch, not floating cards
Display type used sparingly and set very tight; DM Sans carries everything else
Restraint: the accent marks actions and state, never decorates
Legibility treated as a safety property, not a preference

rules.name: The Fills-Only Rule
rules.body: Dispensary Green (#0f673c) is forbidden on text, small icons and focus rings. It fails WCAG AA against Counter Black - a legibility failure on a page where the words are drug names and dosages. Green type uses Signal Green (#34d98a) or #4ade80. No exceptions, and no "it's only a label."

rules.name: The Red Means Stop Rule
rules.body: Cross Red never celebrates. If a red element is not an error, a warning or a destructive action, it is the wrong colour.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: One green light in a dark room. If a screen has green competing with green, or the accent is doing decorative work, the screen has lost the metaphor.

rules.name: The Signage-Only Rule
rules.body: Syne is signage. It appears on the landing hero and section headings, and nowhere in the app - not on buttons, labels, table headers or data. A display font in a UI label is the fastest way to make a tool feel untrustworthy.

rules.name: The 16px Floor Rule
rules.body: Body and input text never drop below 16px on mobile. This is an accessibility floor and an iOS zoom guard at once.

rules.name: The Objects-Not-Cards Rule
rules.body: If a surface has a drop shadow and no edge, it is floating, and it is wrong. The lip is the system. A shadow alone is a card from another design system.

rules.name: The Press-Is-Physical Rule
rules.body: Pressable things depress. Touch feedback is scale(0.98) or a 3px translate within 120-140ms - never a colour flash, never nothing.

dos: Do use Signal Green (#34d98a) for every green word, small icon and focus ring.
Do give every surface an edge. The lip is the system.
Do keep hover behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine), and give touch a press state instead.
Do hold body text at 16px minimum, at 4.5:1 or better, with a 65-75ch measure.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion on every animation - motion here is state, not decoration.
Do show a skeleton for anything over 300ms. A spinner in the middle of content is an apology.
Do keep the three auth domains visually distinct. Customer, staff and partner surfaces should never be mistaken for one another.
donts: Don't use Dispensary Green (#0f673c) for text or small icons. It fails AA on the dark base.
Don't rebuild this light. PRODUCT.md rejects a "light, clinical, generic-healthcare theme" by name, and tasks/DESIGN.md rejects a light theme explicitly. The dark base is settled.
Don't reach for a marketplace or discount-pharmacy look - the drop-shipper aesthetic is the exact suspicion this product exists to overcome.
Don't put Syne in the app. Display fonts in UI labels, buttons or data are prohibited.
Don't use neon, purple/pink gradients, or gradient text (background-clip: text). Emphasis comes from weight and size.
Don't use emoji as structural icons. lucide-react SVG only, one family, consistent stroke.
Don't ship a floating card: a drop shadow with no edge belongs to a different system.
Don't use Cross Red for anything that isn't an error, a warning or a destructive action.
Don't animate a section into visibility from a hidden default. If the animation never fires, the section ships blank.
Don't let a heading overflow its column. Test the copy at 375px, not just on a desktop.
